name: American Perpetual — product & clearing
tagline: No-expiry single-stock future, held by hourly funding, cleared at OCC
summary: A cash-settled, no-expiry security future on 100 shares of a U.S. stock or ETF, held to its stock by an hourly funding rate (TWAP of (Mark − Index)/Index ÷ 24) and listed as one 101-name class on MIAX Futures.
